description_en: Retrieves a list of connections that match the specified filters
description_zh: 批量查询满足条件的身份绑定
kebab_example: aliyun devs list-connections --label-selector platform=github --page-number 1 --page-size 100 --keyword auto- --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListConnections

parameters.description_en: An array of label selectors to filter results. Returns connections that match all specified labels. Each selector acts as an AND condition.
parameters.description_zh: 利用实体的labels字段进行筛选。精确匹配labelSelector数组中的所有条件，不同条件之间是“且”的关系
parameters.help_en: An array of label selectors to filter results. Returns connections that match all specified labels. Each selector acts as an AND condition
parameters.help_zh: 利用实体的labels字段进行筛选。精确匹配labelSelector数组中的所有条件，不同条件之间是“且”的关系
parameters.name: label_selector

parameters.description_en: The page number of the results to return. The value must be 1 or greater and defaults to 1 if not specified.
parameters.description_zh: 当前页码，默认为1。页码从1开始
parameters.help_en: The page number of the results to return. The value must be 1 or greater and defaults to 1 if not specified
parameters.help_zh: 当前页码，默认为1。页码从1开始
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.description_en: The number of results to return on each page. The value must be between 1 and 100 and defaults to 100 if not specified.
parameters.description_zh: 每页大小，默认为100。取值范围1~100
parameters.help_en: The number of results to return on each page. The value must be between 1 and 100 and defaults to 100 if not specified
parameters.help_zh: 每页大小，默认为100。取值范围1~100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.description_en: A keyword for a fuzzy search on the `name` field of the entity. The search is case-insensitive.
